R11. Backups are deleted by the cleanup job that runs at 03:00 UTC.

## 5. Restore
R12. A restore overwrites the production database with the selected backup after one confirmation click.
R13. The confirmation click is the only check before a restore starts.
R14. Incremental backups run every day at 01:00 UTC.
e1.text: A restore overwrites the production database with the selected backup after one confirmation click.

finding.title: A restore overwrites production after one click
finding.wrong_outcome: anyone who follows the text as given to the letter ends up with a restore that replaces the production database after a single click (`A restore overwrites the production database with the selected backup after one confirmation click.`, S:23), which means one misclick destroys all writes made since the backup, which is incorrect since it causes data loss.
